BEFORE THE PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
                            OF THE STATE OF MISSOURI

 In the Matter of Evergy Metro, Inc. d/b/a    )
 Evergy Missouri Metro’s Request for          )
 Authority to Implement a General Rate        )             Case No. ER-2026-0143
 Increase for Electric Service                )


                    PUBLIC COUNSEL’S OPPOSITION TO
            NON-UNANIMOUS PARTIAL SETTLEMENT – RATE DESIGN

       COMES NOW the Office of Public Counsel (“Public Counsel”) and opposes Evergy

Metro, Inc. d/b/a Evergy Missouri Metro (“EMM” or the “Company”) and Midwest Energy

Consumers Group (“MECG”), (individually “Signatory” and collectively “Signatories”) to a Non-

Unanimous Partial Settlement – Rate Design filed October 5, 2026, as follows:

       1.     Public Counsel opposes how EMM and MECG propose that rate revenues

responsibilities be shifted among EMM’s customer classes.

       2.     Public Counsel opposes the intra-class responsibility shifts proposed without

customer education.

       3.     Public Counsel opposes reallocating rate revenue responsibilities among customer

classes without a rate mitigation study as Staff recommends.

       4.     Public Counsel opposes each and every one of the following:

       Default non-LLPS rates
              - Adopt Company’s proposed demand thresholds.
              - Adopt Company’s proposed transition from 30-minute to 15-minute billing
              demand measurement.
              - Reactive Demand will be removed from Medium and Large General Service
              - The Company agrees to review voltage differentiated rates in the next EMM
              general rate case to appropriately reflect voltage cost differences.
              Optional Time of Use
              - Adopt Company’s proposal, as modified:
                       o Incorporating the resolving items from the standard rate
       All Electric Rates
               - C&I All Electric Rates will be eliminated.
               TRP Rate
               - TRP rate should be frozen for current customers using this rate in the non-
               residential classes.
                      o In this case, the components of this rate will increase 1.1 times the system
                      average rate increase.
       Rules & Reg acceptance
       Parties and Company agree to the proposed conversion of the General Rules and
       Regulations to Book 3, subject to the changes and corrections identified in the final error
       log dated September 25th (or attached to this settlement whichever is preferred).
       Paragraph 2.05, Temporary Service will be revised to state, “Applications for temporary
       service will be reviewed by Company, as received, and subject to the applicable rates for
       permanent service, rules, regulations, terms, conditions, and orders of all governmental
       authorities having jurisdiction.”
       Non-Standard Metering Service terms will be revised to align with language approved for
       Evergy Missouri West in JE-2026-0139 and consistent with the requirements of 20 CSR
       4240-10.0035.

       WHEREFORE, Public Counsel opposes Evergy Metro, Inc. d/b/a Evergy Missouri Metro

and Midwest Energy Consumers Group’s Non-Unanimous Partial Settlement – Rate Design filed

October 5, 2026, as set forth above.

                                                     Respectfully,
                                                            /s/ Nathan Williams
